nodes.label: Domino: Decoupling Causal Modeling from Autoregressive Drafting in Speculative Decoding
nodes.author: Jianuo Huang, Yaojie Zhang, Qituan Zhang, Hao Lin, Hanlin Xu, Linfeng Zhang
nodes.rationale: Speculative decoding framework achieving 5.49× speedup on Qwen3-8B by decoupling causal dependency modeling from expensive autoregressive draft execution.

nodes.label: Speculative Decoding Framework
nodes.rationale: Accelerates LLM inference via draft-then-verify: lightweight draft model proposes multiple tokens, target model verifies in parallel; speedup determined by draft quality and drafting cost.

nodes.label: Draft Quality–Cost Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Autoregressive drafters model causal dependencies (high quality) but incur sequential overhead; parallel drafters reduce cost but weaken intra-block dependency modeling.

nodes.label: Domino Architecture
nodes.rationale: Parallel draft backbone produces preliminary distributions; Domino head (causal encoder + low-rank correction) refines with prefix-dependent causal information; adds 56M parameters (+5.3%).

nodes.label: Base-Anchored Curriculum Training
nodes.rationale: Teacher forcing (ground-truth prefixes) + curriculum: initially anchored on base logits (strengthens backbone), gradually shifts to final logits; prevents correction-branch shortcutting.
